firm_data.firm_description: Barbiero Bisch O'Connor & Commander LLP is a multidisciplinary law firm with a personalized, result-driven approach to litigation. Our attorneys are highly skilled advocates, who handle a wide variety of claims in a cost-effective manner.
notable_facts: The firm has a results-driven model.
The firm represents clients before the Office of Professional Medical Conduct, the Office of Professional Discipline, and the New York State Commission of Correction.
The firm handles matters from inception through trial and post-trial appellate practice.

email.subject: AI for Barbiero Bisch O'Connor & Commander LLP, built for results-driven firms
email.body:
Hi Anthony,

Your results-driven model across medical malpractice, construction, and trucking litigation demands precision at scale. Most firms your size tell us they're stretched thin managing complex discovery and case strategy in parallel.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in the Northeast to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your Melville office on Thursday, April 10 to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
